name: Schnick Schnack Pumuckl treibt Schabernack
overview: Pumuckl can no longer stand being alone in the workshop. Curious, the little kobold sets off on an adventure and, after an unintended boat ride on the Isar, ends up right in the middle of Munich. Starting from the English Garden, his turbulent journey back begins. Along the way, Pumuckl causes plenty of commotion, mischief, and unexpected encounters—playful, cheeky, yet always with heart and a strong sense of justice.
